nodes.label: BELENTANI — Guardián de Esferas
nodes.rationale: A complete PWA/Web 3D game implementation using Three.js and Tailwind CSS, centered on the 'Belentani' messianic entity.

nodes.label: Audio System (Web Audio API)
nodes.rationale: Custom audio engine for Belentani game featuring procedural drones, sacred chants, and zone-based ambient sound.

nodes.label: The Five Archetypes
nodes.rationale: Five unique alien entities (Observador X-7, Vanguardia Zeth, Embajador Lira, La Testigo, El Primordial) with distinct behaviors and diplomatic interactions.
